title: The Extraction of Tashkent
author: P. M. Eriksen
blurb: Isandro Marchetti, a whistle-blower living under four names, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
